items.text: Rockies trade Tommy Kahnle to the White Sox for Yency Almonte
Marlins trade cash and Carlos Delgado to the Mets for Mike Jacobs, Yusmeiro Petit and Grant Psomas
Marlins trade Josh Beckett, Mike Lowell and Guillermo Mota to the Red Sox for Hanley Ramirez, Anibal Sanchez, Harvey Garcia and Jesus Delgado
Pirates trade J.J. Davis to the Nationals for Antonio Sucre
Twins trade Willie Banks to the Cubs for Dave Stevens and Matt Walbeck
Braves trade Pete Smith to the Mets for Dave Gallagher
Yankees trade Rob Gardner to the Athletics for Matty Alou
Senators trade Harry Bright to the Reds for Rogelio Alvarez

note: 2026 regular-season games are not in Retrosheet yet, so 2026 here is postseason only, taken from Wikipedia's box scores. Retrosheet adds the full season after it ends.
